tasks: add-flag

Without the option the output must stay exactly as it is now. `--words` may come before or after the file names. Add unit tests for the option to tests/test_linecount.py.

multi-module-refactor

reportgen keeps its readers, aggregators, formatters, and filters in module-level dictionaries in reportgen/registry.py, so two reports in one process cannot use different sets. Replace them with a `Registry` class exported from `reportgen`, with `add_reader(suffix, fn)`, `add_aggregator(name, fn)`, `add_formatter(name, fn)`, and `add_filter(name, fn)` methods, and a `reportgen.default_registry()` that returns a new registry holding every built-in one; nothing may be registered at import time any more. Keep every public function, adding the registry as its first argument to each one that needs it, and give plugins a `register(registry)` function instead of decorators. The command line must print exactly what it prints now; update the tests and the README.
